question.prompt: Write “3 times the product of \(a\) and \(b\)” as an algebraic expression in standard notation. Write the numerical coefficient first and omit multiplication signs.

solutions.explanation: The product of \(a\) and \(b\) is \(ab\), and 3 times this product is \(3\times ab\). When multiplying numbers and letters, omit the multiplication sign and write the number first, giving \(3ab\).
solutions.title: Translate the product and apply notation conventions
